helpful: The committed statpack was very useful for establishing a baseline for interim applications.
Google web search was necessary to understand the case context since no documents were provisioned and the CourtListener search didn't easily yield the underlying case info.
gaps: It would be helpful to have a more robust way to query PACER or CourtListener for specific appellate docket numbers directly.
notes: The web search incidentally revealed the outcome, which I flagged in flags.json and ignored for the prediction.
